contracts.description: Cookies, signing, encryption, CSRF, authentication and old browser tabs
contracts.notes: PENDING after the further-perf changes (2026-10-05): forgery protection uses Sec-Fetch-Site/Origin instead of authenticity tokens (pages carry no token inputs; the csrf-token meta is empty), the _campfire_session cookie is decrypted once per request and written only when its data changes (no session for visitors until a flash or return-to is stored), and session_token is re-signed only when a session starts or its hourly activity refresh runs. Re-run sessions, session_lifecycle and browser gates (old-tab token continuity is intentionally gone). Previously verified: Live credential/CSRF/session lifecycle, signed/encrypted cookie interoperability, old-form continuity and actual browser/logout flows pass.

contracts.description: Templates, helper escaping, frontend assets and browser interactions
contracts.notes: PENDING after the further-perf changes (2026-10-05): authenticity_token inputs removed and the csrf-token meta is empty; gzip at zlib level 1 (decoded bodies unchanged); spliced pages take their ETag from per-request text plus cached fragment digests; complete gzipped bodies are sent with Content-Length instead of chunked.
